Defeat [[Abbot Ramoth]] and bring back the [[Litanies of the Unseen]] to help [[Brother Mizar]] prove that the [[Unseen Ones]] are false gods. 

== Quest information ==

=== Objectives ===
* Defeat Abbot Ramoth and retrieve the Litanies of the Unseen. 
* Return the Litanies of the Unseen to Brother Mizar.

=== Reward ===
* 750 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{w}} {{skill icon|"To the Limit!"}}
* {{r}} {{skill icon|Choking Gas}}
* {{mo}} {{skill icon|Blessed Signet}}
* {{n}} {{skill icon|Demonic Flesh}}
* {{me}} {{skill icon|Mind Wrack}}
* {{e}} {{skill icon|Deep Freeze}}

== Walkthrough ==

Exit the [[Temple of the Ages]] and follow the quest marker west to Abbot Ramoth and his retinue of [[White Mantle Justiciar]]s. You may encounter some [[Bog Skale Blighter]]s and will likely find some hidden [[Spined Aloe]]s on the road, which should not be too hard to dispatch by themselves.

You must defeat Abbot Ramoth, whereupon he will drop the Litanies of the Unseen. Ramoth is a skilled protector [[monk]], so engaging him together with his [[warrior]] guards may be challenging for an unprepared party, though the party size of 8 available from the Temple of the Ages is a boon. Fortunately, Ramoth can be separated from the Justiciars, and their wide wandering range should make it easy to [[pull]] them. If you do end up fighting all of them together, focus on the Abbot; the Justiciars are hardy even without his support, and they do not have to be killed to complete the quest.

Once Ramoth is dead, retrieve the Litanies of the Unseen and return to Brother Mizar for your reward.

== Dialogue ==

=== Initial dialogue ===
:; Brother Mizar
:: ''"Any fool can see that these Unseen Gods of the White Mantle are nothing more than a ruse used by the Mantle to usurp power in Kryta. If I can obtain a copy of their most secret holy tome, the so-called '''Litanies of the Unseen''', then I could prove them false. It is rumored that a powerful White Mantle priest called '''Abbot Ramoth''' is journeying through the '''[[the Black Curtain|Black Curtain]]''' on a mission of some foul purpose no doubt. If you could kill Abbot Ramoth and retrieve a copy of the Litanies of the Unseen, I would be very grateful.''

:: ''Would you assist me in this matter?"''
